definition: A conservative account-level lens for climate mitigation and clean energy, separate from the broad environment and energy lens.

accounts.name: Renewable Energy Program Account
accounts.basis: Renewable energy assistance for agricultural producers and rural businesses.

accounts.name: Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy
accounts.basis: Explicit energy efficiency and renewable energy account.

accounts.name: Advanced Technology Vehicles Manufacturing Loan Program
accounts.basis: Advanced-technology vehicle manufacturing program; account obligations, not loan face value.

accounts.name: Payment to Issuer of New Clean Renewable Energy Bonds
accounts.basis: Explicit clean renewable energy bond account.

accounts.name: Payment to Issuer of Qualified Energy Conservation Bonds

limitations: This is not a comprehensive inventory of federal climate funding, nor a claim that every dollar in each selected account is exclusively for climate mitigation.
Broad fossil-energy research, oil and gas development, general environmental cleanup, climate science and adaptation are not classified as mitigation by this lens.
Mixed accounts such as EPA Environmental Programs and Management may contain climate programs but are omitted until a documented program-level allocation is available.
The lens preserves existing funding scope, non-financing exclusions, source obligations and missing-year treatment. No new dollar allocations are estimated.
